messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: wiki publication list
parts:
Hi list,

Just wondering: would it be a good idea to list publications that used
ggplot2 in their graphics on the new ggplot2 wiki (articles,
presentations, theses, books, etc.)? For one thing I'd be quite
curious to see in what fields ggplot2 is used, and it would be
inspiring to see a variety of end results. I vaguely recall that
Hadley might have asked this before for his own record, too.

Regards,

baptiste
